text:
riley: quick heads-up 1: pushed a small dark-mode tweak PR for console charts + syntax. screenshots in the figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/abc/coal-ink-theme

maria: glanced 1: overall looks good. main concern: primary axis reads slightly green on panels. can we nudge to neutral blue-gray?

ash: @maria can you drop a hex? current axis is #2aa67a

maria: try #5b7fa3 or #6b7f95 to lower saturation

sam_frontend: pushed a preview at /deploy-preview/462. updated css vars:

```
:root {
  --bg: #0b0f12;
  --panel: #0f1417;
  --text: #dbe7ee;
  --axis: #5b7fa3;
  --muted: #8a97a6;
}
```

devon: chart config note: heatmap needs low saturation + contrast on small values. suggest gradient: #071018 -> #14324a -> #5b7fa3 -> #cfe7ff

jorge_a11y: accessibility nit: token-list items at 12px with #8a97a6 on panel bg fail contrast (3.8:1). body text should be >= 4.5:1. options: bold labels, bump size, or use #a9b7c6

design-bot: a11y-check: token-list 3.8, chart-tooltips 4.1, inline-code 4.6

riley: thanks @jorge_a11y. let's bold token labels for now and retest. also syntax palette: teal functions feel noisy next to orange errors

ash: proposed syntax palette: keywords #cfae67, functions #6fc2b0, strings #d6a58d, comments #6e7b85

sam_frontend: prefer fewer warm hues. logs and errors use orange/red, so shift functions to cool steel #6ea5b2, keep keywords warm

maria: +1 on steel for functions. also bump chart stroke from 1px to 1.5px in dark panels

devon: updated chart defaults: strokeWidth: 1.5, borderColor: rgba(219,231,238,0.06)

riley: A/B plan: coal-ink-v1 (current) vs coal-ink-v2 (adjusted). run 48h, 50 users each, measure heatmap task clarity. @design-bot schedule

design-bot: scheduled AB test: coal-ink-v1 vs coal-ink-v2, 48h, 50 users per bucket. will post results

jorge_a11y: after color swap run local check: `npx color-contrast '#0f1417' '#a9b7c6'` -> 4.59:1

riley: awesome. I'll open the PR with vars + chart changes. thanks all :tada:
